welcome.title: Welcome to the Berlin Barbershop Bash!
welcome.body: A two-day event where we randomly match singers, songs, and arrangers; the arrangers have a day to write an arrangement, and the singers have a day to put the arrangement on its feet, and then we have a concert together in the evening. You can come as a quartet, or as individual singers to form a scratch quartet on the spot.
welcome.cta: If that sounds like fun to you, sign up to show your interest!

schedule.intro: The detailed schedule is still under development, but we have a rough plan:
steps: We will gather together to kickoff the event, randomly assign songs and singers, give the arrangers a chance to learn the singers' voices, and give the singers the chance to find a quartet formation that works for them.

This year, we plan to have a couple of songs for each arranger and quartet to choose from. We'll have prepared leadsheets (melody and original chords) and 1:30–2:00 cuts. Cutting down the song to approximately that length is mandatory, but you don't have to use the exact cut we'll suggest.

Arrangers will gather together to arrange their music. There will be opportunity for arrangers to solicit or give feedback for work in progress during the night of arranging, which was a lot of fun last year.
While the arrangers do their thing, the singers will head out on a scavenger hunt across Berlin, most of which will involve sending in clips of singing tags in varying locations or circumstances.

In the evening, after a day of arranging and tagging, we'll exchange music. There'll be an opportunity for feedback from the singers and last-minute edits as the singers have the evening to individually learn their parts.
After that, much-needed rest all around, a day of rehearsal, and then we have ourselves a concert!
schedule.outro: Further details, including timing, venue, costs, etc, to be determined. If you have any questions, please reach out to our team at {email}

faq.title: FAQ
items: Singers may use sheet music as needed for the concert
Arrangers may not also participate as singers
The concert is open to friends and family, but not the general public
The goal is to arrange and perform a piece of any length; if the arranger writes a single chorus or a tag, the singers have that much more time to polish it :)
Yes, there will probably be arranging pancakes again

hair.title: Looking for a Barber Shop?
spiel: Apologies, you've stumbled on the wrong kind of barbershop — we sing, we don't cut hair.

sections.title: Visiting the site
body: There are no cookies, analytics or tracking here. The site is served by Cloudflare, whose servers need your IP address and browser details to send you the pages (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). We don't keep or look at any of it.

sections.title: Interest form
body: If you fill out the interest form, we store your email address and your answers: how you'd like to take part and which dates work for you. That's all. We use them only to contact you about the Bash, and delete them when you ask us to or once we no longer need them. They're stored with Cloudflare in Western Europe.
By sending the form you agree to this (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can change your mind at any time by emailing us.

sections.title: Email and social media
body: If you email us, we use your message only to reply. Our Instagram and Facebook links are plain links: nothing is shared with them unless you follow one.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask us at any time what we have stored about you, and have it corrected or deleted (Art. 15–21 GDPR). Just email {email}. You can also complain to a data protection authority.
